shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && git ls-files | head -50 && echo "---" && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -30

for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/index.css src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo "=== agent_eval"; ls -R __agent_eval__; echo "=== node"; node -v; npm -v

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "=== version" && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && echo "=== styles" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ && echo "=== peer" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependencies)" && echo "=== exports" && grep -n "TextInput\b\|PasswordInput\b\|Checkbox\b\|Button\b\|ThemeProvider\b\|Card\b\|Text\b\|Flex\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -20

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "=== peerMeta" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./$U/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)" && echo "=== controls/layout/theme exports" && grep -rn "PasswordInput\|TextInput\|Flex\b\|ThemeProvider" $U/build/esm/components/index.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/controls/index.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head && echo "=== ThemeProvider props" && cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && echo "=== PasswordInput props" && cat $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts && echo "=== TextInput props" && sed -n 1,80p $U/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && echo "=== Checkbox props" && cat $U/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && echo "=== Card props" && sed -n 1,40p $U/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts && echo "=== Flex props" && sed -n 1,60p $U/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && echo "=== fonts.css" && head -20 $U/styles/fonts.css

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && echo "=== ControlProps" && grep -n -A14 "export interface ControlProps" $U/types.d.ts && echo "=== Button" && sed -n 1,60p $U/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -n "view\|size\|width\|type\|loading\|selected" && echo "=== Text variant" && grep -rn "TextVariant\b\|TEXT_VARIANTS\|export type TextVariant" $U/Text/types.d.ts $U/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "=== Space" && grep -n "Space\b" $U/layout/types.d.ts | head -5 && echo "=== Card BoxProps" && grep -n "spacing\|Spacing" $U/layout/types.d.ts | head -8

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && echo "=== Button types" && grep -n "view?\|size?\|width?\|loading?\|type?\|ButtonView\|ButtonSize\|ButtonWidth" $U/Button/types.d.ts | head -12 && echo "=== Flex gap type" && grep -n "gap?" $U/layout/types.d.ts && echo "=== BoxProps spacing" && sed -n 60,82p $U/layout/types.d.ts && echo "=== Card maxWidth" && grep -n "maxWidth\|width?" $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -5

grep -n "SpacingValue\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head -3 && grep -n "export type SpacingValue\|SPACING_VALUES" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/ | head -3
rm -rf dist && echo "dist/" >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && git status --short
